## ConnectionsModule.receiveInvitation() method

Receive connection invitation as invitee and create connection. If auto accepting is enabled via either the config passed in the function or the global agent config, a connection request message will be send.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
receiveInvitation(invitation: ConnectionInvitationMessage, config?: {
        autoAcceptConnection?: boolean;
        alias?: string;
        mediatorId?: string;
    }): Promise<ConnectionRecord>;
```
